decisions.reason: The bushing clearance and guided-component effects are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, with no obsolete attributes requiring removal.
The independent piston-end arrangement stated in the source message is already represented by a same-message MODIFY; the shaft-to-bushing clearance adds no further change to this Requirement.
Selecting the shaft-to-bushing clearance does not change the established premachining, welding, and final-machining sequence.
The clearance-fit decision does not change the specified shaft-part or bushing materials.
The geometric fit clarification does not alter the assembly-based drawing-numbering rule.
The model-delivery obligation remains unchanged; the source modifies shaft geometry rather than the requirement to deliver a 3D model.
The source provides a design detail but does not change the independent obligation to provide the manufacturing drawing set.
The shaft-to-bushing fit does not change the applicable ČSN/EN standards or drawing-template requirements.
The fit specification is already owned by the scoped shaft-geometry Requirement; the source does not independently change the general drawing-annotation obligation.
